name: pnp-powerplatform-samples-date-range-picker-component
title: Date Range Picker Component
shortDescription: A reusable canvas component for picking a single date or a date range, with booking rules such as blocked dates, no weekends and a maximum length.
longDescription: A reusable canvas component for picking a single date or a date range, built for booking apps. It marks today, disables past days and applies booking rules set through input properties: earliest and latest dates, blocked dates, no weekends and a maximum range length. The app reads the selection from the StartDate, EndDate, DayCount and IsComplete output properties. Each instance keeps its own state, it needs no premium features and it doesn't rely on experimental features.
